# INTRX — The Interaction Library

> A curated, copy-paste library of the web interactions used by award-winning
> design agencies. 549 native patterns are implemented, including the full 52-entry DRAMS collection.
> Each pattern ships three things: a live demo, a single-file HTML+CSS+JS
> snippet, and an LLM prompt that specifies the interaction precisely enough
> to rebuild it in any framework.

Site: https://intrx.vercel.app
Registry: https://intrx.vercel.app/registry/index.json
License: MIT; photographs under the Unsplash License with per-component attribution. DRAMS by 1042 Studio (@mrblackstudio and @karimeshrimp).

## Buttons & Micro-interactions

### Magnetic Button (`magnetic-button`)

Build Magnetic Button in the transparent shell-owned stage with Hover and Reset dock actions, plain JavaScript and no dependencies. Match exact Figma v4 165:1020, every supplied asset byte and intrinsic size, native photo crop and primitive geometry. Keep every original full composition, complete copy, numerical input model and photo cycle. Preserve .12 trailing, .15 spotlight, 90px strict trail threshold, original segmented 1000ms photo flight and 14-degree range, exact quartic and elastic magnetic easing and retargeting, max10-degree tilt and 4800ms idle model. Use the motion system for UI follow/return, press and ring growth. Keep still reduced-motion and coarse-pointer branches, native buttons and links, deliberate keys and touch, six-second native stories, queued held actions, independent caller/viewport suspension and complete disposal. Native/offline photos use800px; live full uses1600px with original photographer attribution and licence comments.
